## [0.58.0](https://gecgithub01.walmart.com/LivingDesign/tokens/compare/v0.57.8...v0.58.0) (2022-08-22)


### ⚠ BREAKING CHANGES

* This updates the design of Form Group, Select,
Text Area and Text Field to align with new specifications:

* Form fields' label changes from floating on container to static above
  the container
* Form fields' and Form Group's label's font weight changes from 400 to
  700
* Form fields have a new size feature
* Helper text's error icon changes position from trailing to leading
* New specification for readonly state

Please read the "Form Updates" article for an explanation of the Form
Field updates:

https://livingdesign.walmart.com/whats-happening/articles/2022-02-09/text-inputs/

### Features

* update form field component design ([2439beb](https://gecgithub01.walmart.com/LivingDesign/tokens/commit/2439beb34554d1d206e4bdb90b23e5dbd82cca50))

## [0.56.0](https://gecgithub01.walmart.com/LivingDesign/tokens/compare/v0.55.5...v0.56.0) (2022-06-20)


### ⚠ BREAKING CHANGES

* **TextArea:** This modifies all of TextArea's design tokens to
align with a major update of the Form Field component.
* Helper text: icon repositioned from trailing to leading.
* Label: removed transition based on state. It is now positioned
  statically above the Form Field.
* Read only: a new state.
* Size: a new feature. TextArea can either be large or small for use in
  compact forms.

Jira: https://jira.walmart.com/browse/LD-2466
* **Select:** this changes and aligns Select to the new specs
* **TextField:** This modifies all of Text Field's design tokens to
align with a major redesign of the Form Field component.

* Helper text: icon repositioned from trailing to leading.
* Label: removed transition based on state. It is now positioned
  statically above the Form Field.
* Read only: a new state.
* Size: a new feature. Text Field can either be "large," which rougly
  matches the dimensions prior to the change, or "small," for use in
  compact forms.

Jira: https://jira.walmart.com/browse/LD-2139

### Features

* **Select:** update Select to match new specs ([4658e30](https://gecgithub01.walmart.com/LivingDesign/tokens/commit/4658e3055bccd6a019c43db92d6b14bb28fd11a9))

## [0.48.0](https://gecgithub01.walmart.com/LivingDesign/tokens/compare/v0.47.1...v0.48.0) (2022-02-23)


### ⚠ BREAKING CHANGES

* This modifies existing icon tokens from a single token
to multiple tokens for color, name, and size. It also removes

## [0.21.0](https://gecgithub01.walmart.com/LivingDesign/tokens/compare/v0.20.2...v0.21.0) (2021-11-17)


### ⚠ BREAKING CHANGES

* **reactnative:** This changes React Native build output from nested JSON
to JS with flat ESM exports.
* This modifies build artifacts' filenames for the
following platforms:

* CSS
* JS
* JSON
* React Native
* SCSS

The change:

* No more build/[platform]/[theme]/globals/* files. Use the single
  build/[platform]/[theme]/globals.ext file for all global tokens.
* No more build/[platform/[theme]/components.ext file for component
  tokens. Use the multiple build/[platform]/[theme]/components/**/*.ext
  files for component tokens.
